Name: CP Dwarven Archaeologist
Author: ahri1014
Description:
[center][font=Verdana][size=4]﻿Overview
[/size][/font][/center][font=Verdana]Obtain the Golden Scythe from the Quarry Mine and get 4 hearts with the Dwarf to unlock a new trader! Features a rotating stock every week, so prepare to bring stuff to trade :)

[center][size=4]﻿Compatibility
[/size][/center]This has not been tested for multiplayer, but there shouldn't be any conflicts. Should work with most big mods as well, but if there is a conflict, please let me know and I will do my best to adjust. Comes with addon patches for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url]! 

Big thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LavenderSkelly?gameId=1303]LavenderSkelly[/url] for adding Ohte to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14916]Dwarf Portrait Replacement[/url]!

[center][size=4]﻿Bug/Conflict Reports
[/size][/center]﻿When reporting a bug or conflict, please leave a short description of the issue as well as your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] in your post. This mod is intended for new saves. The letter may not trigger in a current save, IF yours does not trigger you can try "debug quest DA_IntroQuest" in your SMAPI console. This will automatically add the quest to your log, skipping the letter requirement.

[center][size=4]Translations
[/size][/center]I have provided i18n files for anyone to translate, just please leave me a comment so I know!﻿

[/font]thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/rupnan]Rupnan[/url] for the Spanish translation! (included in the mod)
thank you [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/JA3B]JA3B2[/url] for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33827]Korean translation[/url]!
